{{Quote|Had something happened to Fett, the Grand Army of the Republic would be Thyrsian stock instead of Mandalorian."<br />"Not a bad thing."|Nilo and Xoni|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>}}
'''Xoni''', designated '''RC-1571''', was a member of the elite [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] led by [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Nilo (clone commando)|Nilo]] known as [[Tark Squad]], which was part of the [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. Xoni was nicknamed by his genetic template and trainer [[Sarsius Torne]] after the [[Thyrsian (language)|Thyrsian letter]] for one.

==Biography==
Xoni, [[Nilo (clone commando)|Nilo]], [[Quo]] and [[Kupe]] were [[Thyrsian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] trained by their genetic template, Sarsius Torne of the [[Sun Guard]], to infiltrate the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as part of a deal made with [[Zeta Magnus]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to capture [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. To ensure obedience, all four mercenaries were implanted with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] control bands. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Xoni and his squad were sent to assist [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentices]], Anakin Skywalker and [[Halagad Ventor]], in [[Battle of Skye|liberating]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye]] from Zeta Magnus while disguised as a relief team.

Xoni and the rest of the liberation team snuck into [[Kharys' fortress|Zeta Magnus' fortress]] through [[Entyrmion]]'s subterranean tunnel system located beneath the fortress. While in the cave, the liberation team was attacked by multiple [[Oskan blood eater]]s created by Zeta Magnus which killed many of their [[S'kytri]] guides as well as the [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the S'kytri [[Highland Clans]], [[Klarymére]]. During the fight with one of the blood eaters, Xoni managed to severe a supportive tendon of its heel, sending the creature to crush down. Later, the commando squad was able to kill the blood eaters with a [[Class-D detonator]], although this action angered Obi-Wan, as he believed it was ''"affront to life"''. When the liberation team infiltrated the fortress of Zeta Magnus, Xoni and the rest of Tark Squad led the Jedi commanders into a field of [[R-TechApp Man Trap]]s. Xoni and his squad revealed to the Jedi that they were allied with Zeta Magnus and left them to be [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] by Magnus and his [[Blue-Tark/Legends|torture droid]]. The three Jedi later freed themselves, and while Ventor was chasing Magnus, Kenobi and Skywalker [[Death/Legends|killed]] Xoni and his squadmates in a fierce battle.

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Our armor is environmentally controlled, General.|Captain Nilo, to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story" />}}
Xoni wore specialised [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|Katarn-class commando armor]] with a silver finish like the rest of his squad. He used a [[DC-17m Interchangeable Weapon System/Legends|DC-17m]] interchangeable rifle with a [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|grappling spike launcher]] attachment and a [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]].
